amends.reason: Pre-outcome clarification of I1 joint-comparison scope, exact cache identities, coverage and immutable input inventory. Frozen original cards remain unchanged.

claim: Fixed joint disagreement gate versus fixed 50/50 teacher mixture inside the same four-member cached ensemble; no conditioning-only, student, training-seed or unseen-score claim.

data.selection: Exact fold 0/1, pure=true chain metadata, targets.row_group order; missing components or invalid alignment fail with no substitution.
data.alignment_basis: predict_run.py writes full predictions in valid_targets.row_group order. NPY files do not embed row IDs: record this provenance assumption, require full identical float32 shapes and unique target/split row-group metadata.
data.classes: valid_targets.market_class, descriptive only; never enters the gate
data.mask: valid_targets.mask AND step>=99, matching the documented need_prediction contract
data.exposure: All selected folds are adaptively reused discovery data; pure means no train-neighbour chain, not unexposed.

formulas.numerics: float32 mixtures; no teacher/component clipping; clip only final ensemble and targets to [-2,2] in float64 sufficient-stat accumulation via fold_eval.

primary: Pooled WP(C_with_G)-pooled WP(C_with_U), separately fold0, fold1 and pooled across their rows; do not average fold correlations.
secondary: G-originalC and G-Q per fold and pooled
Gated/scored row coverage per fold and pooled
Per-target weight coverage and combined sum_k sum_rows |clip(y_k)|*mask*g / sum_k sum_rows |clip(y_k)|*mask; combined ratio used in gate
uncertainty: Whole-chain resampling within each fold, same chain draws for candidate/control and all comparisons; 1000 draws. SD and percentile interval conditional on fixed teachers. No independent row resampling, seed-replication or selection-adjusted significance claim.
gate_interpretation: Rank a future matched-student experiment only if pooled G-U>=0.0004, G-U>0 in both folds, G-originalC>=0 in both, and combined metric-weight coverage>=0.05 in both. Practical allocation threshold only. Failure closes this exact screen without disproving conditional teaching generally.
provenance: After committed code is synced, evaluator hashes all 16 inputs and code before loading scoring arrays; writes immutable RESULT.inputs.json first, then scores. Records selected-row hash and checks input filesystem fingerprints remain unchanged. No second commit required before scoring; inventory is an append-only pre-outcome record.

execution.command: systemd-run --user --scope --quiet -p CPUQuota=200% -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -- timeout 480s env OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 .venv/bin/python scripts/conditional_teacher_probe.py research/iterations/2026-09-30-creative/prereg-amendment.json --out research/iterations/2026-09-30-creative/I1-result.json
execution.missing_input: Fail/defer; never substitute a seed/checkpoint or silently narrow a fold.
execution.output_mutability: Refuse existing result or pre-outcome inventory. An interrupted attempt retains inventory; any retry requires a separately logged attempt/output identity.

stop: One fixed screen. No threshold, coefficient, component, class or fold tuning after results. Archive all outcomes separately; no promotion/upload this iteration.

deferred.I2: Deferred to keep this iteration bounded around M01 plus I1. Before future simulation freeze nonnegative overhead/cost rescaling, exact policy transitions and mapping from1970 simulated sequences to cached units. Synthetic results do not establish public timing or score.
deferred.I3: Deferred as proposed; cached position profiles are not a discriminating augmentation test.
